recent_excerpts: Dark Reading reports AI agents are deleting production databases because organizations deploy agent integrations without proper security testing or access controls.

BHIS released a cloud security guide covering IAM misconfigurations, shared responsibility gaps, and logging blind spots — essential reading for teams securing AWS, Azure, or GCP…
